reviews.comment:
El playero no parecía tener ganas de trabajar. Tuvimos que ir a golpearle la puerta. Estaba despierto y no le importó que haya un auto parado esperando con -2°C.
Nos hizo cambiar de surtidor porque supuestamente la manguera no llegaba porque el tanque estaba del otro lado. O me estaba boludeando o las mangueras de ahí miden 40 cm.
La tapa del tanque la abrí yo y la tuve que cerrar yo porque se hizo el boludo cuando le di la llave.
No había nafta super, solo Infinia.

*Para quien no sea de la zona, evite por todos los medios esta ruta, está destruida (mayo 2022 al menos). Si fuera de tierra estaría en mejores condiciones. Hay que ir a 40 o menos en algunos tramos para no romper el auto.

(Translated by Google)
The gas station attendant didn't seem to want to work. We had to go knock on his door. He was awake and didn't care that there was a car stopped and waiting in -2°C weather.
He made us switch pumps because supposedly the hose didn't reach since the tank was on the other side. Either he was messing with me or the hoses there are only 40 cm long. I opened the gas cap myself and had to close it myself because he played dumb when I gave him the key. There was no premium gasoline, only Infinia.

*For anyone who isn't from the area, avoid this road at all costs; it's in terrible condition (at least as of May 2022). If it were a dirt road, it would be in better shape. You have to drive at 40 km/h or less in some sections to avoid damaging your car.
